text: That patchy fog burning off this morning is the only speed bump on an otherwise excellent Friday. Once it lifts, expect a good deal of sunshine, a high near 78, and low humidity that makes it feel even better. There's an outside chance of a stray shower well south of Burlington, but I wouldn't plan around it here. The models are split on that today, actually, with the Euro running wetter than the American and European numbers agreeing on temps in the low 70s while the third model nudges into the mid 70s, so call it a coin flip on whether you notice any moisture at all. The lake's in great shape too, water sitting at 76, winds staying under 15 knots and building a bit late in the day, waves just 1 to 2 feet. Evening plans look great, but it'll cool fast after sunset into the 60s, so bring a layer. Saturday repeats the formula almost exactly, sunny and near 78 with light winds, so if today doesn't work for the water, tomorrow will. Good waterfront window until early evening; after that, layer up.
